title: [Plum pudding: a collection of 8 short animated films]
brief_description: This collection of short animated films directed by eight film students at the Newton Creative Arts Center shows a diverse range of issues that are laced to motivate and for showing students’ achievements. This creative media allows a mixture of students to experiment with film and animation.
